description: 24 original hand-reviewed questions plus 103 LLM-written, validated questions over 781 chunks (14 sources).
annotation: Original 24: single annotator. New questions: written by an LLM from one sampled chunk each (alternating exact_term / paraphrase), gated on a verbatim evidence quote and an answerable-from-chunk check; every chunk containing the quote is labelled relevant. Not independently audited; `lexical_overlap` records how many question words appear in the gold chunk.
